reviews.title: RGB's Cause Clearance Problem With Noctua Coolers....
reviews.comment: Intel Core Ultra 9 285k, Asus motherboard. Memory is incapable of running at advertised speeds. Even with being on motherboards QVL! RBG's are mounted above memory so if you have a Noctua cooler like me, the first dimm slot can NOT be used. Not a huge fan of "random" lighted memory. Now the real time lighting I seen a few times, moves with memory speed is awesome. I have been dabbling with computers for 20 years and I can't get them to run any better than 5300. I use my desktop for DJ'ing. I have 4.5 million songs. My old box would start listing thousands of songs when I typed one letter. Searches were usually less than a second. This new box took 2 mins to find my song.
